user.title: Add Surplife controller
user.description: Discovered controllers are listed below. To add one manually, choose "Enter an IP address" and type the address of the controller.

manual.title: Enter an IP address
manual.description: Enter the IP address of the Surplife controller. A DHCP reservation is strongly recommended so the address does not change.

confirm.title: Confirm controller
confirm.description: Found {model} at {host} with firmware {firmware}. Add it?

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller at that address.
error.not_supported: That address answered, but it is not a Surplife 0xB6 controller.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the controller.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No controllers answered the discovery broadcast. Enter an IP address manually.

enter.name: Enter scribble mode
enter.description: Send the mode-entry command first. Leave on unless the strip is already in scribble mode.

set_segments.name: Set segments
set_segments.description: Apply static colours to the 20 fixed segments.

colors.name: Colours
colors.description: Up to 20 colours. Missing trailing segments are turned off.

set_timer.name: Set timer
set_timer.description: Write one of the six hardware timer slots.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Only used when the action is "Set colour".

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Push Home Assistant's local time to the controller.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Apply a bundled holiday preset. Target several controllers to keep them in sync — this is the local replacement for the app's cloud grouping.
